scope: All 113 genes in the archived OXPHOS leading-edge union. Complex membership is external context, not a result of this experiment. No additional genes are added.
source_snapshot: Locally frozen human UniProt annotations retrieved 2026-11-17; reviewed records matched through exact Ensembl stable IDs. Archived ID versions remain attached to statistics.

NDUFAB1.role: Complex I accessory subunit; also participates in other complexes

COX10.role: Heme synthesis enzyme; not classified as a structural complex IV subunit

COX17.role: Copper chaperone for complex IV assembly; not a structural subunit

COX7A2L.role: Respiratory supercomplex assembly factor, retained separately from structural complex IV subunits

complex_v_note: No structural mitochondrial ATP synthase (complex V) subunit occurs in this 113-gene set. ATP6V genes and ATP6AP1 encode V-type ATPase components and are not mitochondrial complex V. Absence from this selected union is not evidence of no complex V transcriptional response.
